title: feat: Phase 11 L1 (Grid Excellence) + Phase 12 L1 (Record Detail)
body:
Implements all L1 foundation features for Phase 11 (Grid Excellence) and Phase 12 (Record Detail) per ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md.

## Phase 11: Grid Excellence

- **Frozen columns** — `frozenColumns: number` on `ObjectGridSchema`/`DataTableSchema`. Applies `position: sticky` with computed `left` offsets and z-index layering. Last frozen column gets a border + shadow separator.
- **Row height toggle** — `rowHeight: 'compact' | 'medium' | 'tall'` on `ObjectGridSchema`. Toolbar button cycles modes; `cellClassName` adapts padding/font-size dynamically. Toggle only renders when `rowHeight` is explicitly configured.
- **Cell copy** — `Ctrl+C`/`Cmd+C` on focused cell copies value via `navigator.clipboard.writeText`. Works independently of inline editing mode.
- Row grouping (`useGroupedData`) and conditional row coloring (`useRowColor`) were already implemented — marked complete.

```jsonc
// Frozen columns + row height example
{
  "type": "object-grid",
  "objectName": "accounts",
  "frozenColumns": 2,
  "rowHeight": "compact"
}
```

## Phase 12: Record Detail

- **Prev/Next navigation** — `recordNavigation` prop on `DetailViewSchema` with `recordIds`, `currentIndex`, `onNavigate`. Renders chevron buttons + position indicator ("3 of 25") in detail header. Disables at boundaries.
- **RecordComments** — New component. Author avatars (image or initials), relative timestamps, textarea with `Ctrl+Enter` submit.
- **ActivityTimeline** — New component. Type-specific icons/colors for `field_change | create | delete | comment | status_change`. Auto-generates descriptions from before/after values.
- RelatedList was already implemented — marked complete.

## Types added

- `CommentEntry`, `ActivityEntry` in `views.ts`
- `recordNavigation`, `comments`, `activities`, `onAddComment` on `DetailViewSchema`
- `frozenColumns`, `onColumnResize`, `onColumnReorder` on `DataTableSchema`
- `rowHeight` on `ObjectGridSchema`

## Tests

20 new tests (164 total passing across plugin-grid + plugin-detail): RecordComments (9), ActivityTimeline (6), DetailView prev/next (5).
